author: Valerie M Beltran
html:
The cows and the wall of corn just cracked me up!!! I loved exploring the market with you via selfie stick. It made me feel like I was right next to you. I want more of that!
I’d love to see footage of conversations you have with people. One of the things I love most about you is how you’re able to connect with anyone, no matter where they’re from or what their life is like. I would love to see some of the connections you make on your journey. Your empathy is unmatched, and I want to see it in action. Keep up the videos! These are amazing!!!
